punchline: Before Burry was proven right, he wrote down what being wrong would cost.
thirty_sec: In November 2006 Michael Burry told his investors about a 1.687 billion dollar subprime CDS position and a worst-case carrying cost of about 6 percent a year; some asked to withdraw, and the bet later paid off.
question: What does a view you are defending cost you each year until it is proven right?
key_contrast: Courage means waiting with the cost of waiting on paper.
